moments.description: A blank black screen is displayed.
The TodoMVC page loads showing "todos" and the "What needs to be done?" input while the cursor idly moves around.
The user types "Buy milk" into the input field and presses Enter, adding it to the list.
The user types "Finish the hackathon demo video" into the input field and presses Enter to add it to the list.
The user types "Call mom" into the input field and presses Enter, adding it to the list.
The user types "fix login bug" into the input field and presses Enter, adding it to the list.
The cursor idly hovers across the items in the list and around the screen.
The user clicks the check circle next to "fix login bug", marking it completed.
The user clicks the check circle next to "Finish the hackathon demo video", marking it completed.
The cursor moves across the list items without performing any action.
The user clicks "Active" in the footer filter, displaying only active tasks.
The user clicks "Completed" in the footer filter, displaying only completed tasks.
The user clicks "All" in the footer filter, displaying all tasks.
The user clicks "Completed" in the footer filter to filter the list to completed tasks.
